_README: Declared, accepted test failures for scripts/ciSuite.mjs.
This is NOT an exclusion list. Every file in tests/ still runs. An entry
here only says: this exact failure, with this exit code and this message,
is already known. If the file fails for a DIFFERENT reason the runner
reports SIGNATURE_CHANGED and the build fails. If it starts passing the
runner reports UNEXPECTED_PASS and the build also fails, so the list
The list is deliberately EMPTY. A measured run on Windows found 24 of 128
files failing, but at least three of those fail only because of a
Windows path bug in the test files themselves, so those Windows messages
are not evidence of what the Linux CI runner will see. Rather than guess,
the first CI run establishes the baseline: it goes red and prints a
'suggested tests/known-failures.json entries', each with the signature
extracted from the real failure. Review every entry, write a real reason,
and paste the accepted ones into expected_failures below.
A reason must say what the defect is and what would let the entry be
removed. 'Known failure' is not a reason.
